Trust decision: `quote()` must reject any string token containing `\n`, `\r`, U+2028 or U+2029 once a `{ comment }` token has been emitted, because the raw `#` swallows that token's quoting — decided in quote's per-token map via a `sawComment` flag (fix.diff:43-47, fix.diff:55).
`pattern_fit`: none — one function at one place (quote.js), O1=1, no O2 site, and no O8 route (glob/op/comment shapes already reject line terminators at quote.js:38, 47-49, 53; only `quote` emits shell text, index.js:3-4).
Strongest lever: O5 coupled behaviour — newlines in arguments before a comment must stay legal (test/quote.js:17), so an over-broad "reject all newlines" fix breaks real behaviour; it is the only SCOPE lever here.
Biggest red flag: `single_site` (plus `tiny_repo`); `fix_minutes` ≈ 15.
